business_problem: Ztore needed to modernize an e-commerce architecture that could no longer keep up with changing customer demand, intense retail competition, and the need for more efficient product discovery and seller-side supply operations.
solution_summary: Ztore used Alibaba Cloud to strengthen the digital core of its Hong Kong e-commerce platform with search and customer-communication services tailored to online retail. The company adopted Alibaba Cloud OpenSearch as a managed search layer so its team could stop building and maintaining search infrastructure by hand and instead focus on improving relevance, efficiency, and accuracy for shoppers. That service is paired with Alibaba Cloud Short Message Service, which gives Ztore programmable outbound communications to reach customers through more efficient marketing and transaction-related messaging. Underneath those services, Alibaba Cloud provides the e-commerce foundation and infrastructure support that Ztore wanted from a vendor with experience running the wider Alibaba ecosystem. The result is a retail stack that helps customers find products faster, supports intelligent communications, and gives Ztore a more adaptable platform for handling fast-changing demand across catalog, fulfillment, and customer-engagement workflows.
business_outcome: Ztore improved the speed and quality of product discovery and customer communications, helping the retailer stay competitive while supporting dynamic business demands.
